_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'it', "theme" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Europe/Rome', "preferences_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "privacy_notice_version" TEXT NULL, "age_band" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "argo_connections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_users (id), "school_ministry_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'family', "secret_reference" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id", "school_ministry_code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "connection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES argo_connections (id), "source_profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "academic_year" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("connection_id", "source_profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_profiles (id), "academic_year" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_subject_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "academic_year", "name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_profiles (id), "source_primary_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "record_day" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "source_primary_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "homework_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_profiles (id), "source_record_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES source_records (id), "subject_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id), "nested_identity" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_item_id" TEXT NULL, "identity_confidence" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "personal_note" TEXT NULL, "assigned_on" TEXT NULL, "content_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "requires_identity_review" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("requires_identity_review" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deadlines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "homework_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES homework_items (id), "source_due_on" TEXT NULL, "personal_due_on" TEXT NULL, "source_time" TEXT NULL, "school_time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Europe/Rome', "precision" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'date', "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'argo', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "completions" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_users (id), "homework_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES homework_items (id), "is_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_done" IN (0, 1)), "done_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_revision" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "homework_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_users (id), "homework_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES homework_items (id), "remind_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_states" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_profiles (id), "adapter_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "coverage_start" INTEGER NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "homework_identity_mappings" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES student_profiles (id), "source_record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nested_identity" TEXT NOT NULL, "homework_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "source_record_id", "nested_identity"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diagnostic_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "area" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX profiles_by_connection_year ON student_profiles (connection_id, academic_year)
CREATE INDEX subjects_by_profile_year ON subjects (profile_id, academic_year)
CREATE INDEX source_records_by_profile_day ON source_records (profile_id, record_day)
CREATE INDEX homework_by_profile_state ON homework_items (profile_id, source_state)
CREATE INDEX homework_by_profile_subject ON homework_items (profile_id, subject_id)
